a: A campaign carries four subcollections: sessions, quests, npcs and locations, each read by members and written by the DM only. Every record has an is_known or state flag so the DM reveals it. A map pin carries record_kind and record_id so the text lives in the record, not the pin.

A CampaignMap carries min_zoom, max_zoom, layers and markers. A layer replaces the picture once the zoom enters its band, and a marker draws only inside its own min_zoom to max_zoom band. A marker can carry link_map_id to jump to another map. MapCanvas owns pan and zoom, MapIcon draws the twelve glyphs.

q: Suno has no public API in 2026
a: Suno publishes no public developer API. Generation is web app only and the developer API is exploratory with a curated partner group, no endpoints or date. Third party relays such as sunoapi.org and gcui-art/suno-api proxy the account through their own servers, so a key pasted there is handed to them. dndcs lists Suno as blocked in src/lib/integrations.ts.

q: dndcs replicate key was written empty into the profile
a: auth.service signUp wrote replicate_api_key and display_name as empty strings into the profile document and the real values only to users/uid/data/details. Fixed to write both into the profile, so $userProfile.replicate_api_key resolves.

q: dndcs firestore rules were expired and denied everything
a: firestore.rules allowed access only until 2025-06-23, so every client request was denied. Replaced with a real ownership model: users own their profile and data subtree, characters by owner, viewers, editors, campaign DM or public flag, campaigns by DM and player_ids, chat sessions by user_id, everything else denied.

q: dndcs how a sheet component reaches the rules engine
a: CharacterPage provides getRulesStore(chStore) on the rules context. A component reads $rules.resolved and takes its value from attributes, skills, saves, senses, pools or derived, falling back to the stored number while the system loads. src/lib/rules/sheet.ts maps stored titles to system ids.

src/components/ui/Button.svelte and Field.svelte are the only button and form primitives, written in the components-nimtech house style. Root class dnd-<component>, variant dnd-<component>-<value>, tokens only, no literal colours.

A rule system is JSON under public/sources/systems with attributes, skills, saves, senses, pools, derived and progression. Every number is an expression evaluated by src/lib/rules/expression.ts against a flat scope. extends layers systems, getMergedSystem merges by id, getResolvedCharacter resolves in dependency order.

q: dndcs character page shows a fixture not saved data
a: engine.ts:408 getCharacter returns testCharacter from character.test.ts. CharacterPage never reads Firestore and never uses the :id route param, while CharacterCreatePage writes real characters to Firestore.

q: dndcs AI features cannot work in production
a: auth.service.ts writes replicate_api_key but Chat.svelte:119 and CharacterSourceImport.svelte:824 read $userProfile?.replicateApiKey. Every Replicate call also targets /replicate, a Vite dev proxy that does not exist on Firebase Hosting.

q: dndcs has a live Replicate key committed in git
a: test/test.hurl carries a Bearer r8_ key, tracked since commit 7a3724b and present in HEAD. It needs revoking, not just deleting. dist/ is also tracked, 35 files.

q: dndcs tsc is TypeScript 7 despite the package pin
a: node_modules/.bin/tsc resolves to @typescript/native 7.0.2. The typescript package stays at ~6 only because svelte-check reads typescript/package.json and throws on major 7.

q: dndcs firebase hosting serves the wrong folder
a: firebase.json hosting.public is 'public', which holds only static assets and no index.html. Vite builds to 'dist'. Deploys ship no app.
Frontend only static Vite 8 + Svelte 5.57 SPA, Firebase Hosting from dist. No server. pnpm 11 keeps onlyBuiltDependencies in pnpm-workspace.yaml, not package.json.
svelte-check 4.7.6 refuses bare typescript 7. It needs typescript@~6 plus @typescript/native@npm:typescript@7 and the --tsgo flag on the check script.
